name: Voxel Bricks
definition: A hierarchical culling structure where voxels are grouped into 8x8x8 bricks. Empty bricks are marked in a brickmap to skip traversal of their contents during ray marching.
summary: Voxel Bricks is a space-skipping acceleration structure for voxel ray marching that groups voxels into fixed-size 8x8x8 blocks and uses a sparse index to skip empty regions, offering minimal structural overhead for interactive worlds.
